meta.purpose: Candidate events that did not clear the auto-publish bar (see ingestion-policy.json) and are awaiting human review via the 'event-review' GitHub Issue. Auto-published candidates never appear here -- they go straight into site/data/events.json.
meta.candidateFields: id, sourceId, sourceUrl, discoveredAt, extractionMethod ('ai'), event{}, verifierConfidence (0-1), verifierConcerns[], blockingReasons[], reviewedAt, reviewedBy
